narr: Showers and thunderstorms developed during the afternoon hours across the Ohio Valley ahead of an upper level low pressure system moving through the region.
ev: Several people were rescued from their homes along Main Street due to rising water.
Portions of State Route 725 were impassable due to more than one foot of water running over the roadway. High water was also reported on Sugar Valley Drive and near Dillman Road.
